question: How do I connect JustRide for the first time?
steps: Turn on Bluetooth and keep the powered device close to your phone.
Sign in, open Device, and choose the pairing option. Allow the requested Bluetooth permissions.
Select your JustRide device and finish the pairing prompts. Check the connection status before starting navigation.
keywords: pair bluetooth permission first setup

question: Which phone permissions do I need?
steps: Allow Nearby devices or Bluetooth when pairing. Older Android versions may also require location for scanning.
Allow precise location for navigation and turn on the phone’s location services.
Call or notification features need their own permissions. Review the app’s permission prompts and Android settings; only enable what you intend to use.
keywords: permission denied nearby location notifications gps

question: How do I start my first ride?
steps: Safely stop before setting a route. Open Go from the destination search on Home.
Choose a start and destination, review the route and start navigation.
Confirm the device is connected and receiving directions. Use the phone route to check instructions before moving.
keywords: start ride route go destination

question: How do I set or change a destination?
steps: Open Go and enter the destination or select a saved place.
Review the selected place and route before starting.
Stop safely before changing an active route or destination.
keywords: search destination address places route

question: Why is my JustRide not appearing in Bluetooth search?
steps: Check that the device is powered on and close to the phone, and that Bluetooth is enabled.
Allow the requested Nearby devices and location permissions. Return to Device and scan again.
If the device belongs to another account, release it from that account first. If it still does not appear, create a connection ticket.
keywords: not found scan search bluetooth pairing no device

question: Why does Bluetooth keep disconnecting?
steps: Stop safely and check the phone’s Bluetooth status and device power. Keep them close together.
Check whether Android battery restrictions are stopping JustRide in the background. Review permissions in the phone’s app settings.
Reconnect from Device. If it repeats, note when it happens and include those details in a support ticket.
keywords: disconnect range pocket background battery unstable

question: Why is the device connected but not receiving directions?
steps: Confirm that a route is active in the JustRide phone app; a Bluetooth connection alone does not start navigation.
Check the phone’s GPS location and the route shown in the app.
Return to Device to confirm the JustRide connection. If instructions still do not arrive, stop navigation safely and report the issue.
keywords: connected no data sync synchronize directions empty

question: How do I reconnect after a restart or lost connection?
steps: Keep the powered device near the phone and open JustRide.
Check Device for a connected status. If it remains disconnected, use the connection or pairing controls for your registered device.
Return to navigation and verify the destination and next direction. Do not assume a restarted device has restored the full route.
keywords: restart lost reconnect resume automatic out of range

question: Can I switch to another phone?
steps: For the same account, sign in on the new phone and connect from Device. Avoid maintaining competing Bluetooth connections.
For a different account, first unlink the device from the current account using its registered email verification code.
Only after the device is released should the new account pair it.
keywords: new phone transfer switch account pairing

question: How do I remove a linked device?
steps: Open Device Settings and choose Unlink Device.
Request the unlink code, then enter the code sent to your registered email.
Wait for the backend to confirm the unlink. This releases the device for another account; deleting only a phone Bluetooth entry does not release account ownership.
keywords: unlink remove unpair release email otp

question: Why is the map not showing on the device?
steps: Check that the phone app has loaded a route and has an internet connection for its map and route services.
Confirm the hardware is connected in Device and the phone has a current GPS fix.
If the phone shows a route but the device does not, note the app and firmware versions and create a navigation ticket. A static product image is not a guarantee of every firmware layout.
keywords: map not showing blank black display loading

question: Why is my location inaccurate?
steps: Allow precise location for JustRide and turn on location services.
Move to a place with a clearer view of the sky when safe; buildings and tunnels can affect GPS.
Wait for the phone’s location to settle before starting. Report repeated jumps with the time and circumstances, without sharing private locations unnecessarily.
keywords: gps inaccurate location jump tunnel weak signal

question: Why does the device show a different route from my phone?
steps: Check that the route is active in JustRide rather than only in another maps app.
Verify the destination and Bluetooth connection. Allow time for a route update after a deviation.
If the mismatch continues, stop safely and create a navigation ticket describing what the phone and device each show.
keywords: different wrong route mismatch reroute

question: Why is the navigation arrow pointing the wrong way?
steps: Check the destination and next maneuver on the phone before moving.
GPS heading may be less reliable while stationary or moving slowly. Wait for a stable location fix.
If the maneuver remains wrong during normal travel, stop safely and report it. Do not follow an instruction that conflicts with the road.
keywords: arrow direction heading turn wrong compass

question: What should I do if navigation freezes or keeps refreshing?
steps: Stop safely. Check whether the phone location and route are still updating.
Check internet, location permission and the Bluetooth connection. A network interruption can delay a fresh route request.
Reopen navigation and review the route. If the issue repeats, record the error text and approximate time for a support ticket.
keywords: frozen freeze refreshing repeated refresh internet offline stops

question: What if navigation stops when my phone screen locks?
steps: Stop safely and reopen JustRide to check whether the route and device connection are active.
Review JustRide’s location permissions and Android battery/background restrictions in phone settings.
Keep the app open while troubleshooting. Background behavior varies by Android phone; report the phone model and software version if it still stops.
keywords: screen locked background stops battery optimization other apps

question: How do I check my firmware version?
steps: Open Device and Device Settings for the connected device’s firmware information.
Use the version reported by the device when available. A cached version may not describe a device that has just been updated.
Include the reported version and app version in a firmware support ticket.
keywords: firmware version installed current software

question: How do I update device firmware?
steps: Park safely and open the firmware update controls in Device.
Check the release details, a stable Bluetooth connection and adequate power before starting.
Follow the on-screen update flow. Do not ride, disconnect Bluetooth or power off during installation. Confirm the reported version after reconnecting.
keywords: ota firmware upgrade update install download

question: What should I do if a firmware update fails?
steps: Keep the phone and device close together and record the displayed error.
Check device power and Bluetooth before retrying from the app’s firmware update screen.
Do not install an unknown firmware file or repeatedly interrupt the device. If it cannot reconnect or the update fails again, contact support.
keywords: ota failed update error interrupted recovery

question: Where can I view previous rides?
steps: Open Recent on Home or the ride history screen to view rides stored for your account.
The latest saved ride is also shown on Home. Refresh after ending a ride.
Sign in with the same account on another phone to view its backend-stored rides. Unsynced local rides are not available on the new phone.
keywords: history previous rides recent latest new phone

question: Why is my ride history missing?
steps: Confirm you are signed in to the account that recorded the ride.
Reconnect to the internet and reopen ride history so pending uploads can retry.
Older app versions did not store all rides on the backend. An interrupted or unsaved ride may be unavailable; support cannot promise recovery of records that were never saved.
keywords: missing history lost ride recover pending sync restart

question: How do I edit my account information?
steps: Open Profile and choose Edit Profile.
Review your name and phone number, save the changes and wait for confirmation.
If a phone number is already reserved by another or deleted account, use your own eligible number or contact support.
keywords: edit profile name phone account information

question: How do I change or reset my password?
steps: For an email/password account, use Change Password in Profile and enter the current password.
If you cannot sign in, use Forgot Password on the login screen and follow the email instructions.
Google sign-in uses your Google account. Never send a password or email verification code in a support ticket.
keywords: forgot password reset change login google

question: How do I delete my account and ride data?
steps: Open Profile and choose Delete Account. A linked device must be unlinked with its own email code first.
Request the separate account deletion OTP, enter your current password for a local account and confirm permanent deletion.
Profile content, rides, saved places and support records are removed. Email and phone remain reserved and cannot register again. The deletion OTP expires after 10 minutes and permits five attempts.
keywords: delete account privacy data email phone otp permanently
